WithinSetSplit: SHA256(seed/provider/set/format/draft_id); disjoint entire-draft evidence/target groups; no outcomes in sample selection
BulkReplay: Lowest seed hash 128 whole drafts per supported calibration/development pick dataset; if fewer than 50k fully ranked, extend deterministically to 160, then 192; no outcome filtering
ProfileSample: 8 hash-selected whole drafts per eligible legacy dataset; detailed equivalence sample 2 drafts each from WOE/LCI/MKM/OTJ before/after optimization
QualityCountPolicy: Audit production path/docs/owned caches and reconstructed presence/copy definitions before compatible parameter fits. Unknown or nonmatching cohorts are not exact provider bridges. No mixing count units.
SelectionPolicy: Fit count-specific fixed k and existing simple EB option on calibration; development checks only; do not fit BLB/DSK or MH3/DFT. Retain k500 when production compatibility is unidentified.
PriorContract: Primary usable wins; credible same-set/different-format semantics-compatible alternate becomes explicitly labeled conservative prior; otherwise neutral; directional reliability stays unqualified without multi-set evidence
CandidatePolicy: At most current + one compatible-count research candidate with portable prior; no reopening B/C absent new evidence
ResourcePolicy: Reuse Phase B data read-only; acquire ONE/MOM compact public tables only; bounded row-group processing; no full per-card explanation traces in bulk; preserve every candidate and exact optimizer behavior
HoldoutRelease: None during B.1; MH3/DFT untouched; BLB/DSK spent
